AAPL.business: Designs and manufactures consumer electronics, software, and services including iPhones, computers, tablets, wearables, and digital platforms.
AAPL.edge: Strong brand loyalty, vertically integrated hardware-software ecosystem, and premium pricing power supported by high customer retention.

GOOGL.business: Alphabet operates Google's search engine and advertising platform, along with cloud services, hardware devices, and other technology ventures through subsidiaries.
GOOGL.edge: Dominance in search and digital advertising, supported by vast data collection, network effects, and significant barriers to entry for competitors.

MSFT.business: Develops and sells software, cloud computing services, and hardware products including operating systems, productivity applications, and gaming platforms.
MSFT.edge: Dominant market position in enterprise software and cloud infrastructure, with deep integration across its product ecosystem and substantial switching costs for corporate customers.

NVDA.business: Designs and manufactures graphics processing units (GPUs) and system-on-chip processors used in gaming, data centers, artificial intelligence, and professional visualization.
NVDA.edge: Dominant market position in GPU architecture and software ecosystem (CUDA) that creates high switching costs for customers in AI and data center applications.
